name: Glass Hime
source:
A mysterious book found by a librarian. It is a story of a girl of glass.

Princess Glass is a sheltered girl who has lived all her life in a castle in order so that her body, which is made of glass, doesn’t break. But one day a robin flies in and they decide to go on a journey together…

[From [url=https://tico-tl.tumblr.com/post/669211128506777600/glass-princess]Tico Translations' blog[/url]]
translation:
图书管理员发现的一本神秘的书。这是一个玻璃少女的故事。

格拉斯公主是一位受庇护的女孩，她一生都生活在城堡里，这样她的玻璃身体就不会破碎。但有一天，一只知更鸟飞来，他们决定一起去旅行……

[来自[url=https://tico-tl.tumblr.com/post/669211128506777600/glass-princess]Tico Translations的博客[/url]]
